recommended_action: Close the alert as a false positive due to corporate proxy / VPN routing behavior where two distinct geo-locations (Paris and Amsterdam) map to the same enterprise SASE network IP address (203.0.113.7).
summary: The atypical travel alert triggered due to sign-ins from Paris and Amsterdam within 40 minutes using the exact same IP address (203.0.113.7), which belongs to a corporate SASE/VPN network range (EXAMPLE-SASE-NET). Both sign-ins were successful and originated from the same trusted egress node, indicating routine proxy routing rather than malicious credential compromise or impossible travel by an individual user.
